violations.text: Menus are lacking Allergen Advisory statement. Allergen Advisory statement is required to inform customers of their obligation to inform staff of any food allergies. New Violation. Correct By: 07/18/2026

Establishment's Rhode Island Certified Food Safety Manager license is expired. FMC to re-instate. Food safety certificate is current. Application provided during time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026

Raw chicken was observed thawing in stagnant water in food prep sink. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must be thawed in one of the following manners: under refrigeration (41 degrees Fahrenheit or less); completely submerged under running water; as part of the cooking process; or in the microwave if cooked immediately after thawing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2026
Mop sink did not have dispensable hot water available during time of inspection. PIC states part is on order. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Protective shielding is not provided for the lights in the kitchen area. Light bulbs must be shielded, coated, or otherwise shatter-resistant in areas where there is exposed food; clean equipment, utensils, and linens; or unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. New Violation. Correct By: 01/12/2024
